meta.title: Mutabil — moving in Cluj with the price and time known up front
meta.description: Configure your move and see the van, crew, hours, guaranteed window and every price line right away. Reusable crates, assembly, protection.

landing.title: Book your move like a flight.
landing.lead: See the price, the arrival time and what is included — before you call anyone. No haggling on the day.
landing.exact: Or make a detailed estimate, ~3 minutes
landing.passTitleSample: This is what an estimate looks like
landing.passNote: A range until the survey. Details in one click.

fares.title: Three fares. The differences are written down, not hidden.
fares.lead: The fare decides how certain the price is and how well your things are protected. Every option can be changed on its own.
fares.estimateFor: You only want to know the cost
fares.fixedFor: You want a certain sum after a survey from photos or video
fares.completeFor: You want to worry about nothing
fares.includedAll: In every fare: tape, stretch film, blankets, dollies, floor and door protection.

extras.title: Extras: what you add to the move
extras.lead: Every option shows its unit price right here. Nothing is pre-selected.
extras.cratesText: We bring them {before} days before and collect them {after} days after. No boxes to buy, none to throw away.
extras.cratesPrice: {rate} lei / crate · {days} days included · then {extra} leu / day
extras.wardrobeText: Clothes travel on hangers, just as they hang in the wardrobe.
extras.mattressText: A clean mattress on arrival, no dust, no scratches.
extras.assemblyText: A craftsman takes the furniture apart beforehand and puts it together on arrival. The crew does not wait for him.
extras.assemblyPrice: from {bed} lei / bed · {wardrobe} lei / large wardrobe
extras.packingText: Partial (kitchen and fragile items) or complete. Done the day before.

journey.title: How it goes
journey.requestText: You configure and send. Free and with no obligation.
journey.surveyText: Photos, video or a visit. Then you get the fixed price.
journey.cratesText: Arrive a few days before, if you chose them.
journey.moveText: The crew arrives in the window you picked. You know from the start how long it takes.

rules.title: How we calculate
rules.lead: The same rates you see in the estimate. There are no others.
rules.overtime: One hour beyond the guaranteed window
rules.overtimeText: van + crew, the same rate, billed per 30 minutes
rules.capText: the final price does not exceed the confirmed estimate by more than {remote} % (photo/video) or {onsite} % (visit), if volume and access are as described
rules.note: All prices are in lei and include 21 % VAT. Rates are being verified.

faq.title: What happens if…
faq.q1: …there are more things than I said?
faq.a1: The crew lead shows you what changed and what it costs before any extra work starts. Nothing is added without your consent.
faq.q2: …the lift is smaller or out of order?
faq.a2: If you chose “Not sure”, we have already priced a small lift. If there is no working lift at all, we carry by the stairs under the same rules as in the estimate.
faq.a3: The configurator warns you in advance and prices the stairs for that item. Furniture that comes apart travels as panels.
faq.a4: With basic protection we are liable as the law provides. With complete protection we repair, replace or pay the declared value, with no discussion about wear.
faq.q5: …the crew is late or works longer?
faq.a5: The end of the window is written in the estimate. If we overrun because of us, you do not pay above the cap.
faq.q6: …I don't know the answer to a question?
faq.a6: Choose “Not sure”. You will see right away what we assume and how much the price can change.
